source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: To use Daemonic Pact, each of your army’s models needs at least one of these keywords: **HERETIC ASTARTES**, **CHAOS KNIGHTS**. The rule lets you recruit **LEGIONES DAEMONICA** allies even with a different [Army Faction](vsdata:core-rule/select-army-faction). Pool their points against one allowance: Incursion 250, Strike Force 500 or Onslaught 750. None of the allied models may be **WARLORD** or take Enhancements. Check **KHORNE**, **TZEENTCH**, **NURGLE** and **SLAANESH** separately. For a given god, each daemon unit outside **BATTLELINE** needs a separate **BATTLELINE** counterpart bearing that god’s keyword.
